---
description: Step 8 - Prepare changelog, PR description, and pull request
agent: agent
---

## Scope

Local repository paths only. Detect Node and Python stacks. No GitHub URL cloning, no --branch, no network retries. Everything else in docs/requirements.md stays in scope. Record deferred items in Known Limitations. Never modify samples/; it is a read-only test target.

## Task

Read docs/requirements.md, docs/architecture.md, docs/impl-plan.md, docs/code-review.md, and docs/verification.md. Inspect the actual branch diff and git status. Do not claim unrun tests, unresolved findings, or deferred requirements are complete.

Append a UTC `YYYY-MM-DD` dated entry to CHANGELOG.md summarizing actual implementation and documentation changes; preserve existing entries and do not duplicate an entry for the same changes.

Write docs/pr-description.md with exactly these main sections:
1. Summary
2. Changes Made
3. Test Evidence
4. Known Limitations
5. Reviewer Checklist

Include traceability to implemented FR/NFR IDs, commands and measured results, remaining review findings, and explicit deferrals for URL/cloning/branch/retry and Java/Maven/Go stack work. Include partially deferred FRs/NFRs and unverified gates rather than hiding them. Keep all output free of secret values.

Inspect git remotes without printing credential-bearing URLs. Check `gh` availability and authentication without exposing tokens. PR publication is development workflow, not an implementation of deferred GitHub URL input; do not add application network behavior.

If a suitable remote and authenticated gh CLI are available, ensure the intended changes are committed on feature/doc-sync without including unrelated work, determine the actual remote and base branch, push the branch, and create the PR using docs/pr-description.md as the body. Prefer a draft PR if required checks or findings remain unresolved. Do not create a duplicate if an open PR already exists for the branch.

Otherwise, do not install gh, invent a remote URL, or guess a base branch. Report the exact PowerShell-safe commands to authenticate if necessary, push feature/doc-sync, and run `gh pr create --body-file docs/pr-description.md` with the verified remote, base, title, and head. Clearly label any required user-supplied values that cannot be discovered. Use separate commands, never bash-only syntax or &&. Do not modify samples/.
